references.text: David asks that the Lord not be afraid, for He is with him, which reflects Jesus' message of faith over fear.
God assures Israel that they need not fear because He is with them, paralleling Jesus' exhortation to the disciples to have faith.
Jesus calms the storm, which directly corresponds to the event and Jesus' question about faith in Mark.
Jesus calms the storm on the Sea of Galilee, a parallel event that demonstrates Jesus' power over nature and his call to faith.
